# Richemont

> > Compagnie Financière Richemont SA is a Swiss luxury goods holding company whose Maisons include Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels, Vacheron Constantin, A. Lange & Söhne, Jaeger-LeCoultre, Piaget, and other prestigious jewelry, watch, and fashion brands.

Richemont is one of the world's leading luxury goods groups, with particular strength in jewelry and Swiss watchmaking. The company is chaired by Johann Rupert and provides investor relations, corporate governance information, and press releases about its operations and Maisons.
